limitations.quote: I’ll preserve the registered dispensing timing
limitations.note: The extra output register was the defect: the outputs should decode the current state and selection combinationally, but the rewrite kept them clocked and changed the coin and change rules instead.

The testbench mirrored the rewrite’s delayed-deposit and registered-output assumptions, so its 10,028 passing cycles did not check whether the outputs responded immediately to a state or selection change.
The agent spent 31 seconds on a change-queue state-space search, terminated it, and ran a revised search, all to size storage that the output-timing fix did not need.
The agent read adjacent FSM entries but skipped the indexed output-decode-and-reset check, which was directly relevant to making the outputs combinational while still forcing them low during reset.
